themes.title: Permanent living and residencies
themes.original: Permanent residents, medium-term residencies and short stays are all part of the original Noonuccal-led concept.

themes.title: Site areas and clustered layout
themes.original: About 15 acres described; 13.4 acres traced inside the firebreak; 1.02 km around the measured path. Small clusters retain scrub and room for shared life.

themes.title: Clean-up and material sorting
themes.original: Clean, sort and record the land before choosing what gets repaired reused moved or disposed of.

themes.title: Existing dwelling transition
themes.original: Consider shared use of the handmade dwelling after a suitable replacement expandable home is established.

themes.title: Expandable buildings and containers
themes.original: 20 expandable 40-foot, 20 expandable 20-foot and 30 standard 20-foot structure options require individual uses specifications and staged decisions.

themes.title: Flexible visitor places and sandy tracks
themes.original: 40 tent swag or small-van, 15 caravan or larger-rig and 10 bus or house-truck options sit alongside sandy tracks and turning loops.

themes.title: Shared kitchen cold storage and amenities
themes.original: A shared kitchen cold storage and three amenity blocks connect daily living gatherings and guests.

themes.title: Food forest orchard nursery and Tower Farm
themes.original: Food forest bush orchard gardens bush tucker nursery and the Tower Farm and Seedling Hub have distinct growing plans.

themes.title: Ceremony and cultural grounds
themes.original: Ceremony yarning teaching and gathering follow relevant Noonuccal direction, with room for restricted and public uses.

themes.title: Making repair and learning
themes.original: A suitable 7-Mile work area starts with useful repair tool sharing material sorting and supervised learning.

themes.title: Separate labs and service interfaces
themes.original: Maker-Space Tip Loop and Capsule Surge offer useful ideas and possible interfaces, each with its own site and operating choices.

themes.title: Commons water harvesting and services
themes.original: Commons water harvesting household loads gardens food service and shared facilities need one coordinated service plan.

themes.title: Stages and operating decisions
themes.original: Work from cultural direction and on-ground records into a selected stage, with permanent living cultural activities and stays considered separately.
